headlines.title: One of football's most-hyped 16-year-olds - what next for JJ Gabriel?
headlines.description: BBC Sport looks at why JJ Gabriel's move from Manchester United to Real Madrid has caused such a stir.

headlines.title: Arsenal frustrations grow as winless home run continues
headlines.description: Arsenal remain without a home win in the WSL as they play out a goalless draw with West Ham, increasing the pressure on Renee Slegers.

headlines.title: Arsenal go six points clear after lively draw at Newcastle
headlines.description: Noni Madueke's second-half goal earns Arsenal a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park, as the reigning champions move six points clear at the top of the Premier League table.
